name: Task-Tracker
description: Self-hosted, multi-user task tracker for small teams — Kanban board, inline-editable table, timeline, calendar with holidays, workload and reports, with per-project roles, field-level permissions and real-time (SSE) sync.

paragraphs: A self-hosted, multi-user task tracker - a lightweight project management tool for small teams. Kanban boards, an inline-editable table, timeline, workload, calendar and reports, with per-project roles, field-level permissions, custom workflows and automation.

TaskTracker is a single-tenant project and issue tracker intended to be run by a team on its own infrastructure. It keeps the workflows teams actually need — configurable statuses, per-project roles, field-level permissions, time tracking and reporting — without the weight of an enterprise suite.

The app is built on Next.js 16 (App Router) + Prisma 7 + SQLite (via better-sqlite3), so a fresh clone runs with zero external services: no database server, no Docker, no cloud account. The Prisma schema uses only portable types, so a PostgreSQL move is mainly a datasource-provider change — note the committed migrations are SQLite SQL and would be regenerated for the new database.
features: Board (Kanban) with drag-and-drop status changes and per-column quick-add.
Table view with inline editing, resizable columns, filters and a task drawer; row
deletion goes through a confirmation dialog, and the hidden-column + width layout is remembered on the device per project (survives reloads).
One task store per project — the Board, Table, Timeline and drawer read and write the
same rows (optimistic updates, rollback on failure, SSE refresh), so a change in one view appears in the others immediately and no duplicate tasks are created.
